faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.internet.a: A connection is needed to download a Whisper model the first time. Dictation itself is processed locally once the model is available.
faq.upload.a: No. Audio and transcripts are processed locally. Optional diagnostics are separate and opt-in.
faq.games.q: Does it only work with World of Warcraft?
faq.games.a: No. Decktation includes WoW, Guild Wars 2 and Generic behavior for other compatible text fields.
faq.speed.a: Short messages can be ready in under a second after you release the buttons. Timing varies with your device, the selected model, message length and how busy the game is.
faq.open.a: Yes. The source code, releases and issue tracker are available on GitHub.
faq.devices.a: Designed for Steam Deck and controller-driven SteamOS systems. Hardware and controller compatibility can vary.
faq.offline.a: Once the required Whisper model is downloaded, dictation is processed locally without a cloud transcription service.
faq.permissions.q: Why does the plugin need elevated permissions?
faq.permissions.a: Decktation reads controller input and enters text through Decky permissions. Dictated text is handled as data, never executed as a shell command.
final.title: Keep your hands on the controller.
final.body: Install Decktation and start dictating in your games.

install.label: INSTALLATION
install.title: Do you already have Decky Loader?
install.yes: Yes, I have Decky — Install Decktation
install.no: No, this is my first Decky plugin — Set up Decky first
install.developer: Open Decky Settings and enable Developer Mode.
install.whyBody: Decktation is awaiting approval for the official Decky Store. Direct URL installation currently requires Decky’s Developer Mode.
install.urlHelp: Choose Install Plugin from URL in Decky’s developer options. Paste this URL and confirm.
install.setup: Choose your game and language, then enable Decktation. Focus a text field, hold L1 + R1, speak and release to write your message.
install.once: Decky is a one-time setup. Once installed, plugins are managed from Gaming Mode.
install.deviceWarning: Do this part on your SteamOS device.
install.addressHelp: Once in Desktop Mode on your Steam Deck, open Firefox or another web browser. Enter decky.xyz/download in the address bar to download the official installer.
install.run: Open the downloaded installer and choose Latest Release.
install.firefoxHelp: If Firefox names the file decky_installer.desktop.download, rename it to decky_installer.desktop. Move it to your desktop and double-click to open it.
install.zipHelp: Download the ZIP on your Steam Deck. In Gaming Mode, open Decky Settings → Developer → Install Plugin from ZIP, select the downloaded file and confirm. No need to type the URL.
install.desktopHelp: On your Steam Deck, press the Steam button, open Power and choose Switch to Desktop. Wait for the desktop to appear.
install.adminHelp: The installer will guide you through administrator permissions. If you already have an admin password, enter it when asked. If not, it offers to set a temporary password and remove it when the installer finishes. You do not need to create one beforehand or use the terminal.
